Motor CityTurf Wars

Nobody knows your name yet. You start with one weed plant in the backroom and three people in Midtown who want to try it. Free samples turn them into clients. Grow, sell, reinvest. Set your price, answer texts on your burner, meet clients on time and build them from Neutral to Loyal. Your Dodgy Venom is parked outside the stash. The Ambassador Bridge to Canada stays closed for now.

How clients work

Clients text orders sized to their budget and your list price. Accept, counter or decline, then pick a meet window and show up on time. A better relationship and higher addiction mean more orders and bigger markups. Friendly and Loyal clients introduce friends, marked with a ? on the street. Deals after 10 PM pay 15% more.
